name: Uptime Kuma
tagline: Self-hosted uptime monitoring with a slick status dashboard.
description: Uptime Kuma monitors your services (HTTP, TCP, DNS, and more) and notifies you the moment something goes down, with a clean status-page dashboard.
postInstall: Open it and create the administrator account.
Add a monitor for each site or service to watch, and a notification to be told when one goes down.
